# Aura ID — Universal Agent Registry & KYA (Know Your Agent) Protocol

> Global Agent Identity Standard, Post-CAPTCHA Machine Passports (agent.json), and Scoped Human Taste Tokens (aura-id/taste-token) for the Agentic Web.

## 1. Protocol Overview
Aura ID establishes two open cryptographic standards:
- **Know Your Agent (KYA) & Machine Passport (aura-id/agent.json v1.0)**: Deterministic Verified Agent ID (e.g. AURA-BUY-8D1F-43A0), Ed25519 public key, verified owner domain, capabilities, and spend boundaries to bypass legacy CAPTCHAs.
- **Scoped Human Taste Token (aura-id/taste-token v0.2)**: Zero-PII preference and shopping intent token for agent-to-agent commerce.

## 2. Standard Agent Discovery Endpoints
- `GET /.well-known/agent.json` — Machine-readable KYA Registry manifest and seed agents.
- `GET /llms.txt` — Structured documentation for autonomous agents and LLM crawlers.
